quarterly_data.signal: Correction (filed 08-07-2026) to the power-plant EPC construction contract with Korea District Heating Corporation signed 2024-08-21 (term to 2028-12-01): BHI's share rises to KRW 243,946,121,818 from KRW 239,649,948,000 (66.4% of 2023 revenue, was 65.2%); the total contract is USD 55,045,000 plus KRW 231,612,712,273 excluding VAT (was KRW 226,242,495,000). An amendment to an existing order.
